asset_type: portrait book-cover artwork pilot for Tinct, artwork only
shared_style: Sophisticated limited-palette linocut and letterpress print, visible ink grain on warm uncoated paper, mid-century literary press restraint, flat shapes and strong silhouette.
shared_composition: Exact 2:3 portrait; bold central motif readable at 108x162 pixels; quiet low-detail bands across upper 24% and lower 18% for later deterministic title and author typesetting.
shared_constraints: Artwork only; absolutely no words, letters, numerals, pseudo-text, borders, logos, signatures, watermarks, gradients, or physical-book mockup; original artwork; avoid generic AI fantasy imagery and crowded detail.

prompts.request: A severe ancient city seen as interlocking geometric terraces, with one small cave opening below and a clean shaft of daylight above, suggesting justice, the ideal city, and the allegory of the cave.
prompts.palette: warm parchment, deep blue-black, muted mineral blue, restrained ochre

prompts.request: A vast branching river seen from above, dividing and rejoining through a dry landscape, with a small dawn horizon, suggesting a library of many books, covenant, exile, wisdom, and return without depicting God or a literal holy book.
prompts.palette: warm parchment, deep umber-black, muted lapis blue, restrained gold ochre

prompts.request: One tiny black sail crossing a vast patterned wine-dark sea toward a narrow pale opening between two abstract rocky forms, suggesting danger, cunning, distance, and homecoming.
prompts.palette: warm parchment, deep blue-black, oxidized teal, restrained burnt sienna

prompts.request: Two Regency-era profiles constructed from opposing cut-paper silhouettes, almost facing but separated by a narrow vertical interval, with a subtle country-house window rhythm behind them; wit, misreading, social form, and eventual recognition.
prompts.palette: warm parchment, deep plum-black, dusty rose, restrained sage

prompts.request: An empty dark throne-like chair casting a long split shadow across the stone floor of an austere Elsinore hall, with a small pale opening beyond; surveillance, grief, indecision, and a corrupted court, no skull.
prompts.palette: warm parchment, charcoal blue-black, muted iron blue, restrained blood-rust

prompts.request: Five irregular paths made from distinct line rhythms enter from different edges and nearly converge around one small open circle, while a single broken river shape crosses them; inquiry, travel, competing testimony, cause and consequence, not a literal map.
prompts.palette: warm parchment, deep blue-black, faded Nile blue, restrained terracotta
prompts.extra_constraints: No people, buildings, monuments, boats, compasses, eyes, pictograms, literal maps, or culturally stereotyped icons.

prompts.request: A single broken chain link transformed into the nib of a writing pen, against strong diagonal bands suggesting movement from darkness toward open air; literacy, self-authorship, resistance, and freedom, without depicting a face or body.
prompts.palette: warm parchment, deep near-black, muted indigo, restrained copper
prompts.extra_constraints: Avoid dehumanizing or sensational imagery, plantation imagery, and portrait imitation.

prompts.request: Two opposing fields of small disciplined marks flow around an empty central space like water around stone, with one subtle red seal-like square containing no character; strategy as position, terrain, asymmetry, and winning without collision.
prompts.palette: warm parchment, carbon black, smoke gray, muted cinnabar
prompts.extra_constraints: No Chinese characters, samurai, warriors, swords, or battlefield spectacle.

tinct-cover-v2.style: Painterly, full-bleed, textured and atmospheric literary art. One dominant light source; shared charcoal-indigo, smoke-blue, muted ochre, moon-ivory and umber palette; a single dominant silhouette that holds at 108x162.
tinct-cover-v2.artwork_spec: Text-free original artwork, exact 1024x1536 2:3 portrait. Reserve a quiet upper-third title zone and lower author zone. No embedded text, pseudo-text, logo, signature, watermark, border or physical-book mockup.
tinct-cover-v2.anti_repetition: Every cover gets one declared composition type and unique recipe. No composition type exceeds one third of the set. Reject period shorthand, generic AI illustration and embedded pseudo-text.
tinct-cover-v2.overlay: EB Garamond title in a subtle upper-third scrim; author uppercase/small-caps treatment in matching lower scrim; fixed margins and sizes from render_v2.py.

A black-sailed ship beneath a crescent moon, crossing dark water toward a lit island.
A monumental stair rising to one luminous doorway, with a small side-profile philosopher.
An unmarked letter caught in an open casement window over a rain-softened garden.
A lone throne-like chair and its long diagonal shadow in a cold stone hall.
A single S-curved river and five paths meeting at a distant illuminated ford.
A dignified man in side profile holding an unmarked book at a sea-bright doorway.
A dark square strategy board with plain stones forming an empty channel.
The existing laboratory scene: lone figure from behind within an electric green laboratory.
A worn marble bust facing dawn through a bare arch, treated as an emblem rather than a figure.
